messages:
tara: Heads-up: Cascade-lite + Toolcall SSE (server-sent-events) are GA on hosted in us-east-1 and ap-southeast-1 today. Docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/toolcall-sse — please review before you flip traffic :tada:

josh: Great. Is SSE different from the previous streaming? Any client changes?

tara: SSE uses event-stream frames (data: lines) and supports partial tool outputs as delta events. Backwards-compatible for simple text streams, but toolcall clients should switch to the new `X-Toolcall-Mode: sse` header or query param. Example:
```
POST /v1/generate?toolcall=sse
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer $KEY
  X-Toolcall-Mode: sse
Body:
{ "model": "cascade-lite-1", "stream": true }
```
Response: stream of `data: {"type":"delta","tool":"search","payload":...}` frames. Full examples in docs.

marco: What about billing and quotas for streaming SSE?

tara: Two policy items: 1) streamed tokens are billed per-token as before, but we now also meter "stream-conn" sessions (to protect capacity). 2) Enterprise customers can request higher concurrent stream limits via Console -> Billing. We'll send targeted emails to tenants above 75k tokens/mo. No immediate rate increases for most teams.

josh: Migration plan? Deprecation timeline?

tara: v0 (legacy) streaming will continue for 45 days. We recommend switching ASAP. Deprecation schedule: 45d deprecate legacy stream, 90d disable for new customers, 150d full shutdown. We'll post updates and a migration checklist.

marketing: Need a short external blurb for the launch page and changelog. Can someone draft?

tara: Draft blurb: "Cascade-lite + Toolcall SSE GA — low-latency partial tool streaming for interactive apps, with lower memory footprint and predictable connection quotas." Feel free to shorten.

support-bot: Support playbook created at /docs/internal/hosted/toolcall-sse-playbook. Includes troubleshooting: reconnect patterns, idempotency tokens for tool actions, handling `error` frames.

marco: Any known regressions or gotchas?

tara: A few notes: large binary payloads in tool outputs may require chunking; SSE adds a 90s idle timeout for connections — we recommend clients send keepalive comments (`: keepalive`) for long idle periods. Also, older SDKs may need a small patch for SSE parsing.

josh: Can ops start a canary so we can test telemetry?

ops-bot: Canary started: 8% traffic in us-east-1 for cascade-lite + SSE. Monitors: stream_conn_count, p95_latency, tool_error_rate. Alerts to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

marketing: I'll push the blog snippet and update the status page. Also scheduling a customer webinar next Wed 9am PT.

tara: Thanks. I'll follow up with the deprecation doc and an internal upgrade workshop invite. Please escalate any odd telemetry to #eng-runtime. :rocket:
